title: Spaceship with dinosaurs
content: I keep getting this place that is a space ship with a room that has a giant laser that almost always malfunctions. Then outside this room there is a giant locked metal door. It gets opened and dinosaurs start coming out. Then it goes into a chase type setting. Running from dinosaurs, either I go up and hide in an area called sugar land (or whatever) but at some point a giant T. rex comes out and starts chasing me.
